extracted.name: Chicken a la Crème
extracted.description: Chicken a la crème is a simple, fast, delicious French recipe for chicken tenders in a rich cream sauce. Serve with crusty French bread.
ingredient_lines: 1.5 pounds chicken breast tenderloins or strips
instruction_lines: Melt 2 tablespoons butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Season chicken tenders with salt and pepper and sauté them in hot butter until golden on all sides, about 10 minutes. Add remaining 2 tablespoons butter, reduce heat to medium, and cook for 5 more minutes.

Pour heavy cream into the skillet; simmer gently for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until sauce has thickened and chicken is cooked through. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 165 degrees F (74 degrees C).
